title: Science Against Authoritarianism
description: An open-science research project asking what science - as a method (falsifiability, reproducibility, open data) and as an institution - can measurably do to contain political violence and the growth of authoritarianism worldwide. Synthesises evidence across four lenses (epistemic defense / open science; the social science of violence and democratic backsliding; systems and technology; political economy and institutions), separates replicated findings from contested and speculative ones, and culminates in the design of a concrete, falsifiable, openly-licensed initiative built on open conflict and democracy datasets (ACLED, V-Dem, UCDP, GDELT, Freedom House).
